title: CHAOS;HEAD NOAH

routes.title: 【Silent sky】（1周目）
routes.notes: Mandatory first playthrough from 《START》 (Set A: 1周目は強制で【Silent sky】ルート; Set B chapter 10-A: 1周目では必ずこのルートに入る). Every 妄想トリガー is answered ポジティブ妄想 (LT / Z key, green) throughout (Set A: 攻略チャートでは1周目の妄想トリガーは全て「ポジティブ妄想:緑」; Set B: 1周目は全てポジティブ、もしくはネガティブ, and both sets tie the 実績 ポジティブ人間 to all-positive). Chapter 1 statements in Set A: スク水＋メガネだよね！ YES / 胸に名札が付いていなきゃスク水じゃない！ YES / 白スク水はあり得ない。スク水と行ったら紺色だろ！ NO; Set B only requires スク水+メガネだよね！ YES here and says the rest may be YES or NO. The later chapter-1 statement blocks are 「※１周目では未発生」 in Set A, so they do not appear on this run. Chapter 6 contains the Di-Sword statement quiz (see disagreements). Set A: PC and Switch (unlike Vita/PS3) cannot reuse first-run saves in the second run, so ◆セーブ01–07 are NOT made on this run; ◆セーブ08 (before trigger 43, chapter 9) is explicitly fine to make on this run. Terminal: ノーマルEND【Silent sky】 (Set B: エンディングA). This ending is a hard run boundary: the next section must restart from 《START》. Set B has no save information at all. No heroine route character, so no portrait.

routes.title: 咲畑 梨深
routes.notes: Second playthrough, restarted from 《START》 (Set A 「再度最初から進めて◆セーブ01～◆セーブ07を作成して個別ルートに入ってください」). Route-defining decisions, both sets: chapter 1 スク水＋メガネだよね！ NO; 妄想トリガー1 = ポジティブ妄想; then リボンで髪を結んでいる YES / メガネをかけている NO / オーバーニーソックスを穿いている YES / スカートは長い NO / 敬礼みたいなポーズをする YES (achievement ビシィ！; Set A 「梨深ルート確定」, Set B 「【ポジティブ】(2周目以降) → 梨深ルートへ」). Set A additionally prescribes スク水より競泳水着だろ！ NO and 靴下装備！ オーバーニーソ！ YES (Set B: remaining statements YES/NO either) and sets every later trigger to ネガティブ妄想 (RT / C key, red); those later triggers are not route-defining for 梨深 but are the first half of the 「その目だれの目」 flag collection that unlocks 【crying sky】 (see crying_sky). Set B: 第八章途中から梨深編へ分岐 and the route shares the common route to chapter 8; the chart's chapter 2 チェックシート is submitted with everything ticked (Set A, achievement 誇大妄想家; Set B, same). Terminal: 梨深END【アニマの像】 (Set B 第九章【アニマの像】). Saves ◆セーブ01–07 are created on this run (Set A only); the Set A save order is 01 (before chapter-1 statements), 02 (before trigger 1), 03 (before trigger 2), 04 (before trigger 8), 05 (start of chapter 3), 06 (before trigger 12A) and 07 (start of chapter 7). Portrait: VNDB c4656 咲畑 梨深.

routes.title: 【crying sky】
routes.notes: GOOD END reached from the chapter-7 save made during the 梨深 run (Set A: ◆セーブ07から; the save dependency means this section must follow rimi in play order, but the unlock itself is the silent sky clear plus the flag count). Unlock, both sets: collect the 「その目だれの目」 flag in at least 10 triggers across chapters before the end of chapter 9 (Set B 分岐条件は、各章にある「その目だれの目」を10個以上見ること; Set A 「その目だれの目フラグ一定数必須」). Independent reconciliation of the flag locations: Set A's chart collects 11 flags in total (累計1–11). Set B's per-trigger tables (numbering is offset by +1 after Set A's trigger 12A) agree on every one: Set A trigger 8 (ポジティブ), 9 (ポジティブ), 12 (ポジティブ), 20 (ポジティブ), 25 (ポジティブ) from the common chapters 2–6, then 30 (ネガティブ), 34 (ネガティブ), the chapter-8 flag after 妄想しない on trigger 36, 37 (ネガティブ), 43 (ポジティブ) and 44 (妄想しない) in this section. Set A's triggers in this section: 30 ネガティブ, 31–33 妄想しない, 34 ネガティブ, 35–36 妄想しない, 37 ネガティブ, 38–39 妄想しない, 40–42 ネガティブ, 43 ポジティブ, 44 妄想しない. Terminal: GOOD END【crying sky】 (Set B エンディングB). Set A lists 楠 優愛 and 西條 七海 under this ending; this is read as an ending note, not as a route character, so no portrait.

routes.title: 楠 優愛
routes.notes: Set A: ◆セーブ01から; chapter 1 スク水＋メガネだよね！ NO / スク水より競泳水着だろ！ YES / スイミングキャップはもちろん装備！ NO; 妄想トリガー1 = 妄想しない; then こんなのただの偶然だ NO / これはきっと目の錯覚だ NO / 犯人はこの学園内にいる YES / 僕を挑発しているんだ YES / 今すぐあれを消したい YES (achievement 知・っ・て・る・よ・ね？, 「優愛ルート確定」). Set B: 【妄想しない】(2周目以降) → 優愛ルートへ with the same five statements and answers; Set B's chapter-1 note 「スク水+メガネだよね！：YES or NO どちらでも可」 for this route is consistent with Set A's NO. After the route is fixed every later trigger is 妄想しない (Set A) / free (Set B); chapter-2 チェックシート is submitted with nothing ticked (Set A: 全てチェック無し, achievement リア充; Set B: 全て選択せずに提出). Set B: 第七章終了後、優愛編へ分岐. Terminal: 優愛END【月と太陽】. Portrait: VNDB c4659 楠 優愛.

routes.title: 西條 七海
routes.notes: Set A: ◆セーブ03から. Route-defining decisions, both sets: 妄想トリガー1 = ネガティブ妄想 and 妄想トリガー2 = ポジティブ妄想, then 僕は姉の方が好きです NO / ひんぬーは好きです YES / 七海以外でも３次元での相手はいる NO / 七海はかわいい。それは認める。 YES / 七海たんとチュッチュしたいよぉ YES (achievement おにぃのバカ！, 「七海ルート確定」; Set B 【ポジティブ】(2周目以降) → 七海ルートへ). Set B additionally lists trigger 1 = ネガティブ. Earlier triggers: Set B lists other trigger values before the entry trigger for this route, but the atwiki Q&A (supplementary source, below) states 「各ヒロイン√の妄想トリガーは下に書かれている物以外はどれを引いても無問題。」, i.e. only the listed entry trigger and answers matter, so Set A's all-ポジティブ saves are valid for this route. Set A's note: the trigger ends early, so be careful (トリガーの終了が早いので注意). After the route is fixed all later triggers are 妄想しない; chapter-2 チェックシート with nothing ticked. Set B: 第六章終了後、七海編へ分岐. Terminal: 七海END【day dream】 (Set B writes 【daydream】). Portrait: VNDB c4657 西條 七海.

routes.title: 岸本 あやせ
routes.notes: Set A: ◆セーブ04から. Route-defining decisions, both sets: 妄想トリガー8 = ネガティブ妄想 (Set B: 【ネガティブ】(2周目以降) → あやせルートへ), then きっとFESは僕に救いを求めてる YES / FESの誘惑に乗ってみたい NO / 飛び降りたら、きっと気持ちいい YES / FESと一緒なら死んでもいい YES / すべてから解放されたい YES (Set A spells the last as すべてから開放されたい; achievement 杭を打て, 「あやせルート確定」). Set B additionally requires the earlier triggers 1 = ネガティブ and 2 = ネガティブ or 妄想しない. Earlier triggers: Set B lists other trigger values before the entry trigger for this route, but the atwiki Q&A (supplementary source, below) states 「各ヒロイン√の妄想トリガーは下に書かれている物以外はどれを引いても無問題。」, i.e. only the listed entry trigger and answers matter, so Set A's all-ポジティブ saves are valid for this route. After the route is fixed all later triggers are 妄想しない (Set A). Set A's chapter-6 Di-Sword quiz applies (see disagreements). Set B: 第七章終了後、あやせ編へ分岐. Terminal: あやせEND【罪過に契約の血を】. Portrait: VNDB c4658 岸本 あやせ.

routes.title: 蒼井 セナ
routes.notes: Set A: ◆セーブ05から. Route-defining decisions, both sets: 妄想トリガー10 = 妄想しない, then もっと視姦してください YES / この女になら全力で土下座してもいい YES / むしろ踏まれたい YES / 剣でアッー！されるんですね分ります。 YES / どうせ僕はあの剣で殺されるんだ…… NO (achievement ガルガリ君ソーダ味, 「セナルート確定」; Set B 【妄想しない】(2周目以降) → セナルートへ). Set B additionally requires trigger 1 = ネガティブ, trigger 2 = ネガティブ or 妄想しない and trigger 8 = ポジティブ or 妄想しない. Earlier triggers: Set B lists other trigger values before the entry trigger for this route, but the atwiki Q&A (supplementary source, below) states 「各ヒロイン√の妄想トリガーは下に書かれている物以外はどれを引いても無問題。」, i.e. only the listed entry trigger and answers matter, so Set A's all-ポジティブ saves are valid for this route. After the route is fixed all later triggers are 妄想しない. The chapter-6 Di-Sword quiz applies. Terminal: セナEND【デウス・エクス・マキナ】 (Set B: 第七章終了後、セナ編へ分岐). Set A also lists 折原 梢 and a CG collection note under this ending. Portrait: VNDB c4660 蒼井 セナ.

routes.title: 折原 梢
routes.notes: Set A: ◆セーブ06から. Route-defining decisions, both sets: ポジティブ妄想 on the chapter-3 trigger before the statements (Set A 妄想トリガー12A 「すると確かにそこにいた。」; Set B trigger 13 【ポジティブ】(2周目以降) → 梢ルートへ), then 僕を助けに来てくれた？ YES / 転校生は悪魔払いのプロだ YES / 弱そうに見えるのはカモフラージュだ YES / 梨深を殺してくれるんだ！ YES / ２人で殺し合え！ NO (achievement ドカバキグシャーッ！, 「梢ルート確定」). Set B additionally requires triggers 1 = ネガティブ, 2 = ネガティブ or 妄想しない, 8 = ポジティブ or 妄想しない and 10 = ポジティブ or ネガティブ. Earlier triggers: Set B lists other trigger values before the entry trigger for this route, but the atwiki Q&A (supplementary source, below) states 「各ヒロイン√の妄想トリガーは下に書かれている物以外はどれを引いても無問題。」, i.e. only the listed entry trigger and answers matter, so Set A's all-ポジティブ saves are valid for this route. After the route is fixed all later triggers are 妄想しない. The chapter-6 Di-Sword quiz applies. Terminal: 梢END【殺戮にいたる病】 (Set B 【殺戮に至る病】; 第七章終了後、梢編へ分岐). Set A then lists optional 回収 notes: ◆セーブ02から and ◆セーブ08から (ネガティブ人間 achievement, CG collection) with no further decisions given. Portrait: VNDB c4661 折原 梢.

routes.title: 【blue sky】
routes.notes: TRUE END. Unlock, both sets: all other endings first, then start 【blue sky】 from the title screen (Set A: 他の全END後にタイトル画面より【blue sky】を開始; Set B: 【blue sky】以外の全エンディング(各ヒロインルート含む)を見ると、タイトル画面から新…). Both sets agree on the 15 statements and answers: きみはぼく YES / ぼくはきみ YES / ぼくなんて、いない NO / きみなんて、いない NO / ぼくはぼくじゃない NO / あなたは、おにぃ YES / あなたは、にしじょうくん YES / きみは、たくみ YES / あなたは、たくみしゃん YES / おまえは、にしじょう YES / あなたは、たく YES / ぼくはぼく。 YES / ぼくは、妄想のそんざい。 YES / 僕は、存在する。 YES / 僕は、西條拓巳。 YES. Set B: any wrong choice returns to 【silent sky】 (第十章【silent sky】No.6より分岐). Set A then lists the optional CG-collection run (◆セーブ01から, chapters 2–9, all 妄想しない, 葉月眼鏡無し差分CG) after the TRUE END; it has no ending terminal and is not part of the main route. No heroine route character, so no portrait.

sources.title: 誠也の部屋：別館【CHAOS;HEAD NOAH PC版(Steam版) 攻略】
sources.notes: Set A; written for the Steam release (修正パッチ：無し, updated 22/10/08, 48 save slots, DL専売) and checked against the Vita/Switch versions. Directly fetched (Shift_JIS). Complete trigger-by-trigger and statement-by-statement chart for the first run, all six heroine routes, 【crying sky】 and 【blue sky】, with saves ◆01–◆08. Use for exact Steam wording, trigger order and saves. Tells the player that on PC/Switch first-run saves cannot be used in the second run.

sources.title: 【カオスヘッド】攻略チャート - ゲームライン（chart1, chapter2–9, chapter10-a/b/c, rimi, nanami, ayase, sena, kozue, yua）
sources.notes: Set B; independent Japanese chart (MAGES., last updated 2021-03-21, 攻略チャート with per-chapter and per-route subpages under https://gameline.jp/chaos-head/kouryaku/). Components fetched directly: chart1 (chapter 1), chapter2–chapter9, chapter10-a (silent sky), chapter10-b (crying sky), chapter10-c (blue sky), and rimi, nanami, ayase, sena, kozue, yua. Written before the 2022 Steam/Switch releases (it speaks of トロフィー/実績 and has no platform label), so it is cross-platform evidence of the route structure and decisions, not the exact Steam text. Lists all 45 triggers with the outcome (CG / その目だれの目) of positive, negative and none, every route-defining statement set and its answers, the crying sky unlock and the blue sky unlock. Contains no save information at all, so every save step is Set-A-only.

Gives, per heroine, the entry trigger and the five YES/NO answers (梨深 ポジティブ YES NO YES NO YES; 優愛 妄想無し NO NO YES YES YES; 七海 ポジティブ NO YES NO YES YES; あやせ ネガティブ YES NO YES YES YES; セナ 妄想無し YES YES YES YES NO; 梢 ポジティブ YES YES YES YES NO), the blue sky answers, the 「その目だれの目」 trigger list for the crying sky route, and the chapter-6 sword quiz answers. sources.title: Q&A・攻略 - Chaos;HEAd/カオスヘッド(ゲーム) @ ウィキ (atwiki)
sources.notes: Supplementary Set B component; fan wiki Q&A page for the Xbox 360-era NOAH (page timestamp 2010-04-20), so cross-platform evidence. The page returned HTTP 403 to non-browser access; the user opened it in their own browser and pasted the page source into the session on 2026-10-27, and its 攻略 section is saved verbatim in the project sources. It states that every heroine route's trigger other than the listed entry trigger can be pulled any way (「各ヒロイン√の妄想トリガーは下に書かれている物以外はどれを引いても無問題。」), that entering a heroine route closes the other routes, lists each heroine's entry trigger and the five YES/NO answers (same as Set A and Set B), the blue sky answers, and 18 「その目だれの目」 trigger locations, all of which are among Set B's flag cells (Set B marks 19 cells; the one this page and fllayg do not list is Set B trigger 17, 渋谷駅前, ネガティブ). It puts the 【crying sky】 requirement at roughly 70% or more of those 18 (Set B: 10 or more). Used for corroboration and to settle the earlier-trigger question; it supplies no jpGuide2 text.

sources.title: 【CHAOS;HEAD NOAH】 かんたん攻略 - Trivial Achievements@wiki (atwiki)
sources.notes: Supplementary Set B component; achievement-oriented walkthrough for the Xbox 360-era NOAH (page timestamp 2009-04-22; timings measured on an Xbox 360 Elite), so cross-platform evidence. The page returned HTTP 403 to non-browser access; the user opened it in their own browser and pasted the page source into the session on 2026-10-27, and the relevant lines are saved verbatim in the project sources. It states that the chapter-6 sword quiz answer is YES, YES, NO, NO, YES (the YES, YES, NO, NO, YES path); that for each route it is quickest to start from the save at the route's entry delusion trigger and that such saves should be made on the first run (「各ルートとも、ルートの入り口となる妄想トリガーのセーブデータがあれば、そこから始めるのが速いです」); the 0% / 100% check-sheet achievements, that there are 18 「その目だれの目」 triggers (per the page; Set B marks 19 cells) and that 【crying sky】 needs 一定数以上. Its advice to make the entry-trigger saves on the first run does not apply to the Steam build (Set A: first-run saves cannot be used in the second run). Used for corroboration only; it supplies no jpGuide2 text.

Its table prints, in a single answer column (the header names routes A and B but the saved copy shows one column), the five sword-quiz statements 剣が見えた / はっきりと剣が見えた / ここから動けるなら取りに行ける / ここ以外の場所でもその剣は見える / 実際にそれは剣じゃない with the answers YES / YES / NO / NO / YES (the YES, YES, NO, NO, YES path), and lists five optional delusion triggers around it (its trigger texts differ from Set A's, so it may describe a different release). disagreements: Target: VNDB lists many CHAOS;HEAD NOAH releases for v22505. Five official releases with native Japanese text share the newest date 2022-10-07 (Windows r93152 and four Switch packages), so the default rule is ambiguous and the caller supplied the target: Windows/Steam r93152 (official, ja + en, main language ja). The unofficial Steam/GOG 'Overhaul Patch' (r96648) and other patches are not targets; whether they change any Japanese choice text has not been checked. Cover: r93152's own digital cover https://t.vndb.org/cv/05/75805.jpg. Portraits: VNDB character records c4656–c4661 for the six heroines; silent_sky, crying_sky and blue_sky are not character routes, so their portrait is blank by design (not a failed lookup; the protagonist 西條 拓巳 c4655 https://t.vndb.org/ch/14/4714.jpg exists if the owner prefers it). Trigger system: 妄想トリガー decisions (ポジティブ妄想 / ネガティブ妄想 / 妄想しない) are route-defining decisions in this game, not cosmetic: they select the heroine route together with the following YES/NO statement set and also gather the flags that unlock 【crying sky】, so a route's entry trigger and its five YES/NO answers are the route-defining facts that both primary sets must support; the other triggers on a route's path are not route-defining (the atwiki Q&A says so, see the earlier-trigger paragraph), except that the triggers which gather 「その目だれの目」 flags decide whether 【crying sky】 is reached. For triggers that are not route-defining, Set B often says 'どれでも可' while Set A prescribes a value; Set A's value is used and Set B's flexibility is not a contradiction, but the crying sky flag locations are cross-checked above. Trigger numbering: Set B's numbering is one higher than Set A's from Set A's 12A onward (Set A 12A = Set B 13, Set A 13 = Set B 14, …, Set A 44 = Set B 45). Wording: Set B writes スク水+メガネだよね！, 七海はかわいい　それは認める, 転校生は悪魔払いプロだ, すべてから解放されたい and 殺戮に至る病 where Set A has スク水＋メガネだよね！, 七海はかわいい。それは認める。, 転校生は悪魔払いのプロだ, すべてから開放されたい and 殺戮にいたる病; quote each set verbatim in its own field. Earlier-trigger prerequisites for 七海, あやせ, セナ and 梢 (RESOLVED by a third source): Set B lists trigger values before the route-defining trigger (七海: t1 ネガティブ; あやせ: t1 ネガティブ, t2 ネガティブ/妄想しない; セナ: additionally t8 ポジティブ/妄想しない; 梢: additionally t10 ポジティブ/ネガティブ), while Set A reaches these routes by loading saves ◆03–◆06 taken on its all-ポジティブ template path. The atwiki Q&A (user-supplied copy of a page that blocks non-browser access) states 「各ヒロイン√の妄想トリガーは下に書かれている物以外はどれを引いても無問題。」 and lists only the entry trigger and answers per heroine; Set B's extra earlier values are therefore one working path, not requirements. This is a statement in an independent Japanese source, not an inference. The Trivial Achievements wiki (2009, Xbox 360 era, also a user-supplied copy) says it is quickest to start each route from the save at its entry trigger, which supports the save-at-entry approach but does not by itself say that earlier trigger values are irrelevant; its advice to make those saves on the first run does not carry over to the Steam build, where Set A says first-run saves cannot be used in the second run. Supporting facts that remain true: Set A's template answers the statement block after each earlier route trigger with the inverse of that route's pattern, and fllayg lists only the entry trigger too. The load step of each of the four sections carries a note recording this. Chapter-6 Di-Sword quiz (finding C1 on PR #100, RESOLVED by first-hand evidence): the quiz is a decision tree, not a set of alternating variants. The statements appear one at a time with a YES door and a NO door, and each next statement depends on the previous answer: 剣が見えた, then YES → はっきりと剣が見えた or NO → 剣っぽいものは見えた; はっきりと剣が見えた, then NO → なんとなく剣に見えただけ or YES → ここから動けるなら取りに行ける; 剣っぽいものは見えた, then NO → 幻覚としては見えた; every path then continues with ここ以外の場所でもその剣は見える and 実際にはそれは剣じゃない. The three source-documented paths are therefore not in conflict: Set A (Steam chart) documents YES, NO, YES, NO, YES; Set B (gameline.jp) documents NO, NO, YES, NO, YES; fllayg, the Trivial Achievements wiki and the Gorilla wiki chapter-6 page document YES, YES, NO, NO, YES. Evidence: on the stock Steam build 9206428 (Japanese, Overhaul Patch uninstalled; build identity and file hashes recorded in the contributor's evidence file) the contributor played the quiz six times from one save made just before the fourth chapter-6 trigger and recorded the statements in the order shown on screen, with screenshots: attempt 1 answered YES, NO, YES, NO, YES and saw the Set A statements; attempt 2 answered YES, YES, NO, NO, YES and saw 剣が見えた / はっきりと剣が見えた / ここから動けるなら取りに行ける / ここ以外の場所でもその剣は見える / 実際にはそれは剣じゃない; attempt 3 answered NO, NO, YES, NO, YES and saw 剣が見えた / 剣っぽいものは見えた / 幻覚としては見えた / ここ以外の場所でもその剣は見える / 実際にはそれは剣じゃない; attempts 4–6 repeated attempt 1 and showed identical statements each time (no rotation between attempts). All three paths continued to the next delusion trigger (guide step 40) and beyond (step 41). The same three paths were then played with Overhaul Patch 1.1.3 installed over the same build and the same save, with the same statements, YES/NO doors and results. The author reviewed the screenshots of the first three statements of each stock path (attempts 1–3 and the third statement of attempt 6), the third statement of patched attempts 2 and 3, the trigger screen after the quiz, and the title screen and menu; the remaining screenshots were not individually reviewed by the author and the answers given in each attempt come from the contributor's play notes, because the screenshots show the prompt, not the answer. Combinations other than these three paths were not tried; the sources say a wrong answer ends the game and no source documents a bad-end label, so no bad-end detour is included. The guide's steps keep the answers of the Steam chart (YES, NO, YES, NO, YES), which is the stock-build path played in attempts 1 and 4–6, and the other two verified paths are described in enGuide. The English guides cited by the repository owner on the PR (Kiri Kiri Basara, Final Weapon: YES, YES, NO, NO, YES) agree with the second path. Route-phase decisions: (1) Representation. A statement answer is one step whose simpleJp is YES or NO (the clickable answer); the statement wording sits in jpGuide1 and in enGuide with an English gloss. A delusion trigger is one step whose simpleJp is ポジティブ妄想, ネガティブ妄想 or 妄想しない (the labels both sets use); the trigger number and opening words are in enGuide. The チェックシート is one step named チェックシート with the required action in enGuide. START is the title-screen choice. Checked against the contributor's screenshots of the stock Steam build: the title menu shows START, CONTINUE, CONFIG and EXTRA, and the quiz doors are labelled YES and NO. Delusion triggers have no text label on screen (a green panel at the left edge and a red panel at the right edge), so ポジティブ妄想 / ネガティブ妄想 / 妄想しない are the labels the sources use; チェックシート and blue sky were not captured. (2) jpGuide2 for a trigger quotes Set B's whole trigger block (header plus the three outcome lines); for a route's entry trigger it quotes Set B's header plus the 【…】(2周目以降) → …ルートへ line from that route's page. jpGuide2 for a statement quotes Set B's line only when Set B prints the same statement with the same answer; otherwise it carries the omission placeholder (this includes every deliberately opposite template answer, which Set B covers only as 'YES or NO どちらでも可'). Saves and loads are Set A only. (3) Save numbering follows the recommended order: slot 1 = Set A ◆セーブ08 (made on the first run), slots 2–8 = Set A ◆セーブ01–07, made in the second playthrough that opens the 咲畑 梨深 section; Set A's source numbers are references only. (4) The 咲畑 梨深 section first replays the common route to chapter 7 with ポジティブ妄想 everywhere to create slots 2–8 (Set A: 再度最初から進めて◆セーブ01～◆セーブ07を作成して), then loads slot 2 for the route itself. The loads in every later section are plain loads of those slots and carry no isLoad because the guide has no documented save-backed bad-end detour. (5) The chapter-6 Di-Sword quiz is written as five steps that follow the Steam chart's path (YES, NO, YES, NO, YES), which was verified in-game, and describe the two other verified paths in enGuide; the 優愛 / あやせ / セナ / 梢 / blue sky / 【crying sky】 / 咲畑 梨深 / 【Silent sky】 sections include it and the 七海 section does not (as in Set A). (6) Optional collection runs (Set A's 回収 notes after 梢END and the CG run after 【blue sky】) are not planned as sections. Items that remain open: the on-screen labels of チェックシート and blue sky, and answer combinations other than the three played quiz paths. Sources that could not be inspected and do not count: yuh-nagomi.jp (HTTP 410), h1g.jp (HTTP 403) and isonly.net (unreachable). w.atwiki.jp (chaoshead and trivialachievements) and chaoshead.gorillawiki.jp also returned HTTP 403 to non-browser access; they were then supplied as copies the user made in their own browser, and they count only as supplementary corroboration (see the sources list). masa-wars.hateblo.jp (PS3 trophy notes) was read but only confirms the general flow (first run is always silent sky, flags for crying sky, blue sky from the title) and is not a decision walkthrough. The Kiri Kiri Basara and Final Weapon guides are English and cannot be Set B. Version difference: fllayg says that in the PSP port the title screen does not show blue sky and that blue sky is reached on a run with fewer than 10 flags, whereas Set A and Set B (and the Steam build per Set A) start blue sky from the title screen after all other endings; the Steam instructions follow Set A and Set B. Gate status: Set A, Set B and the supplementary sources (fllayg, atwiki Q&A) independently agree on the route structure, every route-defining trigger and statement set, the unlocks and all nine endings. Before this update the accuracy review accepted 【Silent sky】, 咲畑 梨深, 【crying sky】, 楠 優愛 and 【blue sky】 and requested changes for 西條 七海, 岸本 あやせ, 蒼井 セナ and 折原 梢 (earlier-trigger prerequisites); the atwiki Q&A is the source added to close that finding, pending re-review. Open caveats: (1) the chapter-6 quiz was verified first-hand on the stock build and with Overhaul Patch 1.1.3 (see the quiz paragraph); only the three played answer paths are documented, and the author did not individually review every screenshot; (2) the 【crying sky】 flag threshold is 10 or more in Set B, unspecified ('一定数') in Set A, and roughly 70% of 18 (about 13) in the atwiki Q&A; the chart collects 11, as Set A (the Steam chart) prescribes, and the ending's hint tells the player to collect every flag if it does not appear; (3) START, YES and NO are verified as on-screen texts, the trigger labels are source terms (triggers have no on-screen text), and チェックシート and blue sky were not captured. Overhaul Patch (VNDB r96648, Committee of Zero, v1.1.3): it installs over r93152 and is not the guide target. VNDB's notes and the patch pages describe restored cut scenes, a re-translation, bug fixes and a delusion-trigger tutorial, and none of them documents a change to choices, delusion triggers, the sword quiz or route unlocks. First-hand check by the contributor with v1.1.3 installed over the same build: the three quiz paths above showed the same statements in the same order with the same YES/NO doors and the same results, and an existing save loaded after installation. This is an observation of the quiz only; other parts of the patched game were not compared, and the patch's own English walkthrough (Committee of Zero) prints the same chapter-6 answers YES, YES, NO, NO, YES.
